name: American Perpetual — product & clearing
tagline: No-expiry single-stock future, held by hourly funding, cleared at OCC
summary: A cash-settled, no-expiry security future on 100 shares of a U.S. stock or ETF, held to its stock by an hourly funding rate (TWAP of (Mark − Index)/Index ÷ 24) and listed as one 101-name class on MIAX Futures. OCC clears funding as ordinary variation inside daily settlement, so there is no liquidation engine, insurance fund or auto-deleveraging. Fully specified (124-page spec, 38-page OCC Clearing Brief); nothing filed or signed as of Sep 30, 2026.

ideas.name: Funding is variation
ideas.one_liner: Hourly funding novated at OCC and paid inside next-day variation as its own DDS line

ideas.name: The machine in six lines
ideas.one_liner: Index = NBBO mid; Mark = median(last, bid, offer); rate = TWAP(premium ratio) ÷ 24, final at the lock

ideas.name: OCC computes the cash, not the rate
ideas.one_liner: Exchange furnishes position-free rows; OCC applies them to its book with a per-name zero-sum check

ideas.name: Four corporate-action lanes
ideas.one_liner: Adjust only where arithmetic is exact (cash, whole splits); otherwise terminate and relist

ideas.name: Turnkey §871(m)
ideas.one_liner: The ex-date per-share factor is also the withholding base: factor × 100 × contracts

ideas.name: Two levels of one number
ideas.one_liner: 25,000-contract limit or accountability at 25,000, applied at all times

ideas.name: Margin in four layers
ideas.one_liner: STANS, OFRA scan ranges, the 15% federal floor, and portfolio margin beside stock and options

ideas.name: No liquidation engine
ideas.one_liner: Losses mutualized by a CCP, never socialized by haircutting winners

name: American Perpetual — regulatory road
tagline: Recognition, not relief: a security future under existing law
summary: The perpetual is argued to be a security future because funding supplies 'future delivery' as continuous convergence, so CEA §1a(47)(B)(i) excludes it from 'swap'. No exemption, no-action or pilot is sought. The path is a confidential Harmonization letter to both Chairmen, then one §41.23(b) request for all 101 names, Form 19b-7 and Form 19b-4 (Rule 3.3.2) on the same day, with the Kalshi BTC-perp order (May 29, 2026) cited as persuasive. Every paper was drafted and unfiled at Sep 30, 2026.

ideas.name: Futurity by funding
ideas.one_liner: Funding enforces convergence every hour, supplying the 'future delivery' element

ideas.name: Harmonization letter
ideas.one_liner: 17-page confidential letter to SEC Chair Atkins and CFTC Chair Selig under the Mar 11, 2026 MOU

ideas.name: One §41.23(b) request for 101

name: American Perpetual — platform & operations
tagline: Onyx delta, sentinels, 66-link launch, runbooks an AI agent runs
summary: The Onyx change set is a pinned delta on MIAX's v1.3a interfaces: one new feed message (18, Funding Rate), per-surface 'never expires' sentinels (65535 = June 6, 2149; 9999-12-31; 99991231), ticker+P symbols and a second Onyx instance for the SIP 23×5 session from Dec 6, 2026. Operations are 'autonomous by design': every step is a record-in, record-out job with a check, failures are designed out, and people sign only 15 legally reserved acts. An AI agent can run the runbooks as written. Launch is ten chains of 66 numbered links, and later classes (crypto majors first) reuse the same rails.

ideas.name: Message 18 'Funding Rate'
ideas.one_liner: Predicted value every 5 s, settled value at each :00, on both ToM and DoM

ideas.name: Per-surface sentinels
ideas.one_liner: Say 'never expires' with each field's maximum, never zero (65535, 999912, 99991231, 9999-12-31)

ideas.name: Second Onyx instance

ideas.name: Failures designed out
ideas.one_liner: Each failure has a check and a recovery that run on their own; the desk reviews the log

ideas.name: Autonomous by design
